# criblio_monitor_config_profile (Resource)

MonitorConfigProfile Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "criblio_monitor_config_profile" "my_monitor_config_profile" {
  config_ids = []
  id = "my-profile"
  name = "Production Monitors"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tools/codegen -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config_ids` (List of String) Ordered list of shared configuration IDs attached to this profile.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the profile.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the profile.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional human-readable description of the profile.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent profile ID. Undefined for root profiles.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = criblio_monitor_config_profile.my_criblio_monitor_config_profile
  id = "example"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import criblio_monitor_config_profile.my_criblio_monitor_config_profile "example"
```
